responses.query: SELECT ?p ?label ?comment WHERE { VALUES ?p { <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/countryCode> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasAtcId> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasElevation> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasLatitude> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasLongitude> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasName> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasResponsibleOrganization> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasStationClass> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasStationId> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasTimeZoneOffset> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasWebpageElements> <http://meta.icos-cp.eu/ontologies/cpmeta/hasWigosId> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/identifier> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/isPartOf> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/spatial> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/subject> <http://purl.org/dc/terms/title> <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#contactPoint> <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#theme> } OPTIONAL { ?p <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?label } OPTIONAL { ?p <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#comment> ?comment } } ORDER BY ?p ?label ?comment

note: Flagged fields have no rdfs:comment at the ICOS endpoint; rdfs:label is stored in label_published for reference and is not used as a definition.
